name: Khaled Emam
text:
Amazing experience!!!

I had a truly outstanding experience at Smile Center in Ismailia with Dr. Tantawy Elshahat. I was dealing with a painful wisdom tooth, and after consulting with several dentists who insisted that minor surgery would be necessary, I was lucky to find Dr. Tantawy. His expertise and calm approach made all the difference—he managed the entire procedure smoothly, with minimal pain and no surgery at all. It was honestly a huge relief.

From the moment I walked in, I was impressed by the professionalism and care shown by the entire team—from the receptionist, to the nurses, the scanning specialist, and the doctor’s assistant. Everyone made me feel comfortable, informed, and truly cared for.

Even before my visit, the customer service team was responsive and encouraging, which played a big role in helping me decide to go. I’m incredibly grateful for the excellent care I received and highly recommend Dr. Tantawy and the Smile Center to anyone looking for trustworthy and gentle dental treatment. I will definitely be visiting again for any future dental needs!
